1. PRICE + DEPARTMENT + SHRINKAGE + STOCKTAKE CLUSTERING

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# TRAIN: PRICE + DEPARTMENT + SHRINKAGE + STOCKTAKE CLUSTERING
# new business-grounded clustering space

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

# SHRINKAGE RISK

shrinkage <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/shrinkage.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    items_expected = as.numeric(items_expected),
    revenue_expected = as.numeric(revenue_expected),
    items_lost = as.numeric(items_lost),
    revenue_lost = as.numeric(revenue_lost)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(department))

shrinkage_profile <- shrinkage %>%
  mutate(
    item_loss_rate = ifelse(items_expected > 0, items_lost / items_expected, NA_real_),
    revenue_loss_rate = ifelse(revenue_expected > 0, revenue_lost / revenue_expected, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk =
      0.35 * percent_rank(items_lost) +
      0.35 * percent_rank(revenue_lost) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(item_loss_rate) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(revenue_loss_rate)
  ) %>%
  select(
    department,
    items_lost,
    revenue_lost,
    item_loss_rate,
    revenue_loss_rate,
    shrinkage_risk
  )

# STOCKTAKE RISK

stocktake <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/stocktake_missing.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    item_value = as.numeric(item_value)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(item_value),
    item_value >= 0
  )

stocktake_profile <- stocktake %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    stocktake_count = n(),
    stocktake_mean_value = mean(item_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stocktake_risk =
      0.50 * percent_rank(stocktake_count) +
      0.50 * percent_rank(stocktake_mean_value)
  )

# ITEM-LEVEL RISK ENRICHMENT

long_risk <- long_data %>%
  left_join(
    shrinkage_profile %>% select(department, shrinkage_risk),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stocktake_profile %>% select(department, stocktake_risk),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk = replace_na(shrinkage_risk, median(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stocktake_risk = replace_na(stocktake_risk, median(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_flag = shrinkage_risk >= quantile(shrinkage_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_stocktake_flag = stocktake_risk >= quantile(stocktake_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

risk_features <- long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_shrinkage_risk = mean(shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                           sum(price * shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                                           NA_real_),
    avg_stocktake_risk = mean(stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                           sum(price * stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                                           NA_real_),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                        sum(ifelse(high_shrinkage_flag, price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                                        NA_real_),
    high_stocktake_value_share = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                        sum(ifelse(high_stocktake_flag, price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                                        NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_train_risk <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation,
    avg_shrinkage_risk,
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk,
    avg_stocktake_risk,
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk,
    high_shrinkage_value_share,
    high_stocktake_value_share
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(avg_shrinkage_risk, median(avg_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, median(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_stocktake_risk = replace_na(avg_stocktake_risk, median(avg_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, median(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = replace_na(high_shrinkage_value_share, median(high_shrinkage_value_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_stocktake_value_share = replace_na(high_stocktake_value_share, median(high_stocktake_value_share, na.rm = TRUE))
  )


X_cluster_risk_raw <- cluster_train_risk %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

# 1. Сначала убираем Inf / NaN
X_cluster_risk_raw <- X_cluster_risk_raw %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))

# 2. Заполняем все оставшиеся NA медианой колонки
X_cluster_risk_raw <- X_cluster_risk_raw %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, median(.x, na.rm = TRUE))))

# 3. Убираем константные колонки, где нет разброса
keep_cols <- sapply(X_cluster_risk_raw, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)

X_cluster_risk_raw <- X_cluster_risk_raw[, keep_cols]

# 4. Масштабируем
X_cluster_risk <- scale(X_cluster_risk_raw)

# 5. На всякий случай проверяем
sum(!is.finite(X_cluster_risk))

set.seed(123)
kmeans_model_risk <- kmeans(
  X_cluster_risk,
  centers = 8,
  nstart = 20,
  iter.max = 100
)

cluster_train_risk$cluster_id <- kmeans_model_risk$cluster
centers_risk <- kmeans_model_risk$centers

cluster_train_risk$distance_to_centroid <- map2_dbl(
  split(as.data.frame(X_cluster_risk), seq_len(nrow(X_cluster_risk))),
  kmeans_model_risk$cluster,
  ~ {
    row_vec <- as.numeric(.x[1, ])
    center_vec <- centers_risk[.y, ]
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  }
)

cluster_sizes_risk <- table(kmeans_model_risk$cluster)

cluster_train_risk <- cluster_train_risk %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_size = as.numeric(cluster_sizes_risk[as.character(cluster_id)])
  )

top_150_kmeans_risk_train <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(
    cluster_train_risk %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    risk_features,
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_train$avg_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_train$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_train$avg_shrinkage_risk)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_train$avg_stocktake_risk)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_train$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_train$cluster_size)

write.csv(
  top_150_kmeans_risk_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_kmeans_risk_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
# CASE35: PRICE + DEPARTMENT + SHRINKAGE + STOCKTAKE CLUSTERING on avgs

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# current full risk version

case35_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case35.csv", warn = FALSE)

case35_raw <- tibble(
  raw_line = case35_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case35_long <- case35_raw %>%
  select(transaction_id, basket) %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = stringr::str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case35_basket <- case35_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

case35_dept_share <- case35_long %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case35_basket <- case35_basket %>%
  left_join(case35_dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments,
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = .),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

case35_long_risk <- case35_long %>%
  left_join(
    shrinkage_profile %>% select(department, shrinkage_risk),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stocktake_profile %>% select(department, stocktake_risk),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk = replace_na(shrinkage_risk, median(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stocktake_risk = replace_na(stocktake_risk, median(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_flag = shrinkage_risk >= quantile(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_stocktake_flag = stocktake_risk >= quantile(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

case35_risk_features <- case35_long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_shrinkage_risk = mean(shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                           sum(price * shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                                           NA_real_),
    avg_stocktake_risk = mean(stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                           sum(price * stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                                           NA_real_),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                        sum(ifelse(high_shrinkage_flag, price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                                        NA_real_),
    high_stocktake_value_share = ifelse(sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                        sum(ifelse(high_stocktake_flag, price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                                        NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_case35 <- case35_basket %>%
  left_join(case35_risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation,
    avg_shrinkage_risk,
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk,
    avg_stocktake_risk,
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk,
    high_shrinkage_value_share,
    high_stocktake_value_share
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(cluster_train_risk$sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(cluster_train_risk$max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(cluster_train_risk$top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(cluster_train_risk$dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(cluster_train_risk$items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(cluster_train_risk$price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(avg_shrinkage_risk, median(cluster_train_risk$avg_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, median(cluster_train_risk$value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    avg_stocktake_risk = replace_na(avg_stocktake_risk, median(cluster_train_risk$avg_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, median(cluster_train_risk$value_weighted_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = replace_na(high_shrinkage_value_share, median(cluster_train_risk$high_shrinkage_value_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_stocktake_value_share = replace_na(high_stocktake_value_share, median(cluster_train_risk$high_stocktake_value_share, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_case35_raw <- cluster_case35 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_case35_raw <- X_case35_raw %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, median(.x, na.rm = TRUE))))

keep_cols <- sapply(X_case35_raw, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
X_case35_raw <- X_case35_raw[, keep_cols]

X_case35 <- scale(
  X_case35_raw,
  center = attr(X_cluster_risk, "scaled:center")[colnames(X_case35_raw)],
  scale = attr(X_cluster_risk, "scaled:scale")[colnames(X_case35_raw)]
)

case35_clusters <- apply(X_case35, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers_risk[, colnames(X_case35_raw), drop = FALSE], 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  which.min(dists)
})

case35_distances <- apply(X_case35, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers_risk[, colnames(X_case35_raw), drop = FALSE], 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  min(dists)
})

cluster_case35$cluster_id <- case35_clusters
cluster_case35$cluster_size <- as.numeric(cluster_sizes_risk[as.character(case35_clusters)])
cluster_case35$distance_to_centroid <- case35_distances

top_150_kmeans_risk_case35 <- case35_basket %>%
  left_join(
    cluster_case35 %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(case35_risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_case35$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_case35$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_case35$avg_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_case35$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_case35$avg_shrinkage_risk)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_case35$avg_stocktake_risk)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_case35$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_case35$cluster_size)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_kmeans_risk_case35$transaction_id))

write.csv(
  top_150_kmeans_risk_case35,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_kmeans_risk_case35.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Compact value-weighted risk clustering v2

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

# SHRINKAGE RISK

shrinkage <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/shrinkage.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    items_expected = as.numeric(items_expected),
    revenue_expected = as.numeric(revenue_expected),
    items_lost = as.numeric(items_lost),
    revenue_lost = as.numeric(revenue_lost)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(department))

shrinkage_profile <- shrinkage %>%
  mutate(
    item_loss_rate = ifelse(items_expected > 0, items_lost / items_expected, NA_real_),
    revenue_loss_rate = ifelse(revenue_expected > 0, revenue_lost / revenue_expected, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk =
      0.35 * percent_rank(items_lost) +
      0.35 * percent_rank(revenue_lost) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(item_loss_rate) +
      0.15 * percent_rank(revenue_loss_rate)
  ) %>%
  select(
    department,
    items_lost,
    revenue_lost,
    item_loss_rate,
    revenue_loss_rate,
    shrinkage_risk
  )

# STOCKTAKE RISK


stocktake <- read.csv(
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/stocktake_missing.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    item_value = as.numeric(item_value)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(item_value),
    item_value >= 0
  )

stocktake_profile <- stocktake %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    stocktake_count = n(),
    stocktake_mean_value = mean(item_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stocktake_risk =
      0.50 * percent_rank(stocktake_count) +
      0.50 * percent_rank(stocktake_mean_value)
  )


# ITEM-LEVEL RISK ENRICHMENT

long_risk <- long_data %>%
  left_join(
    shrinkage_profile %>% select(department, shrinkage_risk),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stocktake_profile %>% select(department, stocktake_risk),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk = replace_na(shrinkage_risk, median(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stocktake_risk = replace_na(stocktake_risk, median(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_flag = shrinkage_risk >= quantile(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_stocktake_flag = stocktake_risk >= quantile(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

risk_features <- long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(high_shrinkage_flag, price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_stocktake_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(high_stocktake_flag, price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_train_risk_v2 <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation,
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk,
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk,
    high_shrinkage_value_share,
    high_stocktake_value_share
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, median(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, median(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = replace_na(high_shrinkage_value_share, median(high_shrinkage_value_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_stocktake_value_share = replace_na(high_stocktake_value_share, median(high_stocktake_value_share, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_cluster_risk_v2_raw <- cluster_train_risk_v2 %>%
  select(-transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, median(.x, na.rm = TRUE))))

keep_cols_v2 <- sapply(X_cluster_risk_v2_raw, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
X_cluster_risk_v2_raw <- X_cluster_risk_v2_raw[, keep_cols_v2]

X_cluster_risk_v2 <- scale(X_cluster_risk_v2_raw)

set.seed(123)
kmeans_model_risk_v2 <- kmeans(
  as.matrix(X_cluster_risk_v2),
  centers = 8,
  nstart = 20,
  iter.max = 100,
  algorithm = "Lloyd"
)

cluster_train_risk_v2$cluster_id <- kmeans_model_risk_v2$cluster
centers_risk_v2 <- kmeans_model_risk_v2$centers

cluster_train_risk_v2$distance_to_centroid <- map2_dbl(
  split(as.data.frame(X_cluster_risk_v2), seq_len(nrow(X_cluster_risk_v2))),
  kmeans_model_risk_v2$cluster,
  ~ {
    row_vec <- as.numeric(.x[1, ])
    center_vec <- centers_risk_v2[.y, ]
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  }
)

cluster_sizes_risk_v2 <- table(kmeans_model_risk_v2$cluster)

cluster_train_risk_v2 <- cluster_train_risk_v2 %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_size = as.numeric(cluster_sizes_risk_v2[as.character(cluster_id)])
  )

top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(
    cluster_train_risk_v2 %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train$avg_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train$value_weighted_shrinkage_risk)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train$value_weighted_stocktake_risk)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train$cluster_size)

write.csv(
  top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# CASE36: COMPACT VALUE-WEIGHTED RISK CLUSTERING V2

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

case36_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case36.csv", warn = FALSE)

case36_raw <- tibble(
  raw_line = case36_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case36_long <- case36_raw %>%
  select(transaction_id, basket) %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = stringr::str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case36_basket <- case36_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

case36_dept_share <- case36_long %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case36_basket <- case36_basket %>%
  left_join(case36_dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments,
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = .),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

case36_long_risk <- case36_long %>%
  left_join(
    shrinkage_profile %>% select(department, shrinkage_risk),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stocktake_profile %>% select(department, stocktake_risk),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shrinkage_risk = replace_na(shrinkage_risk, median(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    stocktake_risk = replace_na(stocktake_risk, median(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_flag = shrinkage_risk >= quantile(shrinkage_profile$shrinkage_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_stocktake_flag = stocktake_risk >= quantile(stocktake_profile$stocktake_risk, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

case36_risk_features <- case36_long_risk %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price * stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(high_shrinkage_flag, price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    high_stocktake_value_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(ifelse(high_stocktake_flag, price, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_case36_v2 <- case36_basket %>%
  left_join(case36_risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation,
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk,
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk,
    high_shrinkage_value_share,
    high_stocktake_value_share
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_shrinkage_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$value_weighted_shrinkage_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    value_weighted_stocktake_risk = replace_na(value_weighted_stocktake_risk, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$value_weighted_stocktake_risk, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_shrinkage_value_share = replace_na(high_shrinkage_value_share, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$high_shrinkage_value_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_stocktake_value_share = replace_na(high_stocktake_value_share, median(cluster_train_risk_v2$high_stocktake_value_share, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_case36_v2_raw <- cluster_case36_v2 %>%
  select(-transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, median(.x, na.rm = TRUE))))

keep_cols_case36_v2 <- colnames(X_cluster_risk_v2_raw)
X_case36_v2_raw <- X_case36_v2_raw[, keep_cols_case36_v2, drop = FALSE]

X_case36_v2 <- scale(
  X_case36_v2_raw,
  center = attr(X_cluster_risk_v2, "scaled:center")[keep_cols_case36_v2],
  scale = attr(X_cluster_risk_v2, "scaled:scale")[keep_cols_case36_v2]
)

case36_clusters_v2 <- apply(X_case36_v2, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers_risk_v2[, keep_cols_case36_v2, drop = FALSE], 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  which.min(dists)
})

case36_distances_v2 <- apply(X_case36_v2, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers_risk_v2[, keep_cols_case36_v2, drop = FALSE], 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  min(dists)
})

cluster_case36_v2$cluster_id <- case36_clusters_v2
cluster_case36_v2$cluster_size <- as.numeric(cluster_sizes_risk_v2[as.character(case36_clusters_v2)])
cluster_case36_v2$distance_to_centroid <- case36_distances_v2

top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36 <- case36_basket %>%
  left_join(
    cluster_case36_v2 %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(case36_risk_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid)) %>%

summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36$avg_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36$value_weighted_shrinkage_risk)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36$value_weighted_stocktake_risk)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36$cluster_size)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_kmeans_risk_v2_case36$transaction_id))

write.csv(

)
```
